name: Fist to Five Consensus
deliverable: Rapid non-binary consensus calibration and identification of dissent

steps.text: Explain the scale from fist-block to five-support.
State the proposal, then allow a silent moment.
Reveal together and read the lowest hand.
Ask what single change would raise it to three.
Re-vote once, then record the decision.

failure: The room chases unanimity, spending the session lifting threes to fives while a real blocker goes unheard.
intervention: Say consensus means no blocking dissent, not equal enthusiasm. Ask the lowest hand what would move it.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in consent-based decision practice; no single documented originator.
